links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Readability among all three chatbots was rated poor.
links.quote: Readability among all chatbots was poor.

links.outcome: Reliability of references cited in chatbot responses (0-10 scale)
links.effect: Gemini had the lowest reference reliability score (4.1 out of 10).

links.outcome: Accuracy and comprehensiveness of cannabis/cancer symptom answers, including missing adverse effects and drug interactions
links.effect: Mean accuracy 9.0 (ChatGPT), 8.8 (Gemini), 8.3 (Co-Pilot); comprehensiveness 8.1, 8.5, 7.2. Some inaccurate statements and missing adverse effect and drug interaction information.
links.quote: Inaccurate or misleading statements regarding cannabis formulations and symptom benefits were identified, with missing information on adverse effects and drug interactions.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, comprehensiveness, reliability, and readability of three commercial LLM chatbots answering consumer/patient questions on cannabis use for cancer symptoms, evaluated by expert physicians.
